## Cyber Engine Tweaks 1.38.0

### Game support
- Supports Cyberpunk 2077 patch 2.5 (game version 3.0.88.46235). Earlier patches are no longer supported.

### New
- ImGui docking: CET and mod windows can be docked to each other and to the edges of the screen. ImGui can now change the mouse cursor (resize, text input). (#1046, @notaspirit)
- `ImGuiWindowFlags.NoDocking` is available to Lua mods. (#1046, @notaspirit)

### Fixes
- Fixed a deadlock when a mod registers a hook at runtime. (#1063, @Yiin)
- Fixed a crash when a mod tries to construct an abstract class. It now returns `nil`. (#1055, @budjb)
- ImGui only takes mouse and keyboard input while the overlay is open. (#1046, @notaspirit)

### Under the hood
- Updated to the latest RED4ext.SDK, with the 2.5 changes to function, script stack frame and engine layouts.
- Updated TiltedCore to 0.2.9, with mimalloc pinned to 2.2.4. Building CET now requires xmake 3.1.
